Class SemesterSnapshot

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.SemesterSnapshot
public class SemesterSnapshot extends Object
SemesterSnapshot - Represents snapshot of enrollment data (courses, offerings, and sections) for a list of (CS) courses on a specified date.
